# 00000006221

**English.** Definition: A compactly generated topos is a sheaf topos generated by compact objects. Conjecture: The coherent case is classified by proper maps with closed order table, the kernel of the order being the compact-approximation sheaf. (compact-approximation order of coherent compact generation)

**中文。** 定义：紧生成拓扑斯为紧对象生成的层拓扑斯。猜想：凝聚情形由紧映射分类且阶数表封闭；且阶数的核为紧逼近层。（凝聚紧生成紧逼近阶数）
